description: This Java class provides helper functions for managing external event configurations within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to retrieve, update, and reset external event configuration settings, with some methods marked as deprecated. The class primarily facilitates interaction with the server API related to external event management.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage external event configurations in Fineract, including retrieval, update, and reset functionalities.

methods.name: getAllExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all external event configurations from the server; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: getDefaultExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Provides a default list of external event configuration templates with 'enabled' set to false; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: getExternalEventConfigurationsForUpdateJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string to update specific external event configurations; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: updateExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Updates external event configurations on the server with provided JSON payload; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: resetDefaultConfigurations
methods.description: Resets external event configurations to default (all set to false) on the server; marked as deprecated.
